### Six Blessings God Wants to Give You
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-may-29-2020.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:26-28
Points:
- God sets two definitive alternatives before His people: a blessing and a curse.
- A person's obedience or disobedience directly determines which outcome they receive.
- Scripture promises six specific blessings in exchange for obedience: plenty, peace, protection, power, purity, and perception.
- Obeying God transforms faith from mere knowledge into a close, living relationship with Jesus.
